end.summary:
Heard and discussed “The Cap-seller and the Monkeys.”
Answered one story question about what happened under the tree.
Put story events in order and retold them using first, then, and at last.
Practised past-tense verbs; changed “sleep/sleeped” to “slept” by the end.
Lesson ended after a short break when Navya asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Navya practised sequencing the story and retelling the events with “first, then, at last”; using picture order supported the retell. They explained the cap-seller’s trick and corrected the story tense mix-up later, saying, “He slept under the tree.” At home, ask Navya to retell a short familiar story using those three ordering words and one past-tense verb.
